blocks.x: Hey, why don't you do the review interview, man?
Why don't you do the review interview?
We're having a discussion. We didn't have anything to say 15 minutes ago.

I want to stop and be through with it.
When I stop, I want it to be over with.
I don't know what -- what are you telling me, you want to stop?

Yeah. I'll settle for -- we've got the 15 minutes, if you want to stop.
Okay. Now you're talking about -- the black people making -- all the black millionaires.
